description: Names the BB thread that is making your Mac hot, and lets you stop the dev server or build behind it. A flame in the sidebar footer shows CPU and memory every 2 seconds; click it for the busiest threads, each thread's processes, and a kill that lists what it stops and what it spares before it runs. The Hotspot page keeps seven days of per-minute CPU, memory and thermal history, shades each hot spell, and ranks the threads that caused it. Agents answer "why was my Mac hot at 3pm?" with a built-in tool, and the bb hotspot command answers it in a terminal. Built for macOS, with no account or network service; on Linux it tracks CPU, memory and threads but has no thermal reading, and Windows is not supported.
